SELECT ki.id, ki.kid, ki.uid, ki.kname, ki.share, ki.description, ki.category, ki.data_size as dataSize, ki.knowledge_separator as knowledgeSeparator, ki.question_separator as questionSeparator, ki.overlap_char as overlapChar, ki.retrieve_limit as retrieveLimit, ki.text_block_size as textBlockSize, ki.vector_model_name as vectorModelName, ki.embedding_model_id as embeddingModelId, ki.embedding_model_name as embeddingModelName, ki.system_prompt as systemPrompt, ki.remark, ki.create_time as createTime, ki.update_time as updateTime, ki.create_by as createBy, ki.update_by as updateBy, ki.create_dept as createDept,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_item WHERE kid = ki.kid) as itemCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_fragment WHERE kid = ki.kid) as fragmentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_attach WHERE kid = ki.kid) as attachCount FROM knowledge_info ki WHERE ki.kid = #{kid}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(update_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(1) AS count FROM knowledge_item WHERE kid = #{kid} AND update_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(update_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(update_time, '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(1) AS count FROM knowledge_attach WHERE kid = #{kid} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
